metrics.name: container.cpu.usage.kernelmode
metrics.description: Time spent by tasks of the cgroup in kernel mode (Linux).  Time spent by all container processes in kernel mode (Windows).

metrics.name: container.cpu.usage.total
metrics.description: Total CPU time consumed.

metrics.name: container.cpu.usage.usermode
metrics.description: Time spent by tasks of the cgroup in user mode (Linux).  Time spent by all container processes in user mode (Windows).

metrics.name: container.cpu.utilization
metrics.description: Percent of CPU used by the container.

metrics.name: container.memory.file
metrics.description: Amount of memory used to cache filesystem data, including tmpfs and shared memory (Only available with cgroups v2).

metrics.name: container.memory.percent
metrics.description: Percentage of memory used. Not supported on Windows.

metrics.name: container.memory.usage.limit
metrics.description: Memory limit of the container. Not supported on Windows.

metrics.name: container.memory.usage.total
metrics.description: Memory usage of the container. This excludes the cache.

metrics.name: container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes
metrics.description: Bytes received by the container.

metrics.name: container.network.io.usage.rx_dropped
metrics.description: Incoming packets dropped.

metrics.name: container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes
metrics.description: Bytes sent.

metrics.name: container.network.io.usage.tx_dropped
metrics.description: Outgoing packets dropped.

metrics.name: container.restarts
metrics.description: Number of restarts for the container.

metrics.name: container.uptime
metrics.description: Time elapsed since container start time.

metrics.name: container.blockio.io_service_bytes_recursive
metrics.description: Number of bytes transferred to/from the disk by the group and descendant groups.
